legacyFallback.onGraphFailure: Discard the graph user result and preserve the parallel Legacy result while recording the fallback reason.
legacyFallback.partialPolicy: Do not expose binding Graph totals; report partial and use Legacy as the user result.

shadowComparison.promotionRule: Only pipeline complete plus exact_match may supply a Graph user result; no confidence value causes an automatic switch.

graphPathDisable.mechanism: Omit --engine or pass --engine legacy; activation never persists.

telemetryPolicy: No user telemetry may be added without a later explicit product and privacy decision.

runtimeScope.cli: legacy, shadow and explicitly selected graph_experimental

rollbackAcceptanceCriteria: Legacy remains the default and recommended result source.
Every Graph request also produces a Legacy comparison and fallback candidate.
Disabling Graph requires no migration and no saved-state change.
Fallback source, reason and comparison status are visible in CLI diagnostics.
Desktop and Browser remain on their unchanged Legacy runtime.
